sentences.text: Mannitol has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-09-23, a span of 61 months as of 2026-10-21.
Another registered plant for Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980) was classified OAI on 2026-04-02, after the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980) on 2026-09-29.
B. Braun Medical Inc. is also a labeler for mannitol, but its plant inspection history is not provided in the evidence.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI on 2023-10-13.
Current inventory at Corvale East and Corvale General provides between 8.2 and 15.7 days on hand across presentations.
